test_iat_set_ints: test the iat setter with integer indexes on DataFrames and Series for int64 and uint64 dtypes
test_at_set_ints_other: test the at setter with various index types including object, datetime, and float indexes
test_mixed_index_at_iat_loc_iloc_series: test at, iat, loc, and iloc accessors on Series with mixed-type integer and string indexes
test_frame_at_with_duplicate_axes: test at getter and setter on DataFrames with duplicate column and row labels
test_multiindex_at_get: test at getter and setter on DataFrames and Series with MultiIndex indexes
test_iat_dont_wrap_object_datetimelike: test that iat and at return native Python datetime and timedelta objects for object-dtype columns
test_at_with_tuple_index_get: test at getter on DataFrames and Series with tuple-valued index entries
test_at_with_tuple_index_set: test at setter on DataFrames and Series with tuple-valued index entries
test_imethods_with_dups: test iat and iloc accessors on Series with duplicate integer index values
